summary: Applicability is indeterminate because the facility location/jurisdiction is unknown, so SCAQMD jurisdiction cannot be confirmed. If the coating shop is in SCAQMD, Rule 219 is the relevant official exemption rule for equipment not requiring a written permit, and Rule 201 is the baseline permit-to-construct rule. On the stated facts, a coating/paint operation/coating booth with 60 gal of flammable solvent is not enough to prove a Rule 219 exemption; the project would need a specific Rule 219 listed category and all conditions satisfied. Treat the coating operation as potentially requiring SCAQMD permitting unless jurisdiction is outside SCAQMD or a specific Rule 219 exemption is documented.
title: H-AIR-219: Rule 219 exemption cannot be confirmed for coating-shop solvent storage/coating booth
